question: What auspicious result is the knowledge named Cāpeṭī asked to grant the speaker?
premises: A knowledge is designated by the name Cāpeṭī.
That same knowledge is invoked by the speaker.
The speaker requests the production of auspiciousness.
inference: The knowledge named Cāpeṭī is petitioned to bring auspiciousness to the speaker.
uncertainties: The specific identity and ritual character of the Cāpeṭī vidyā in this witness are not specified.
plain_english: May that knowledge named Cāpeṭī bring auspiciousness to me.
